description: Test suite for plugin management commands in Mattermost's CLI, including add, install, disable, enable, list, and delete plugin commands.

methods.name: TestPluginAddCmd
methods.description: Unit test for adding plugins, including success, no file, error, and multiple plugins with errors.

methods.name: TestPluginInstallUrlCmd
methods.description: Unit test for installing plugins from URL, including success, force flag, partial failures.

methods.name: TestPluginDisableCmd
methods.description: Unit test for disabling plugins, including success, failure, and multiple plugins with mixed results.

methods.name: TestPluginEnableCmd
methods.description: Unit test for enabling plugins, including success, failure, and multiple plugins with mixed results.

methods.name: TestPluginListCmd
methods.description: Unit test for listing plugins in JSON and plain formats, including success and error scenarios.

methods.name: TestPluginDeleteCmd
methods.description: Unit test for deleting plugins, including success, failure, and multiple plugins with mixed results.
